set.body:
Sequential assessment 2026-09-12: Retain P2 core performance. The approximately 300ms body baseline predates retained-layout work: /private/tmp/scalafim-javafx-recovery-20260909 still contains four modified and two untracked follow-up paths above 066be6c, including JavaFxRetainedAtlasSuite and javafx-adaptive-updates.md. Main lacks the adaptive path. Preserve and review this existing candidate instead of rebuilding it from the original hotspot hypothesis. Reproduce on an explicit adopted color/runtime baseline and measure palette/threshold/FIR interaction, upload bytes, CPU/native draw and heap separately. Keep the color oracle and original-ID picks as invariants. No new benchmark or fresh equivalence check is claimed.

Historical context:
Owner: ScalaFIM surface-view-javafx. Consumer: PLS Neuro surface integration bd-01M1YEC2V9X0K7KF8SN321VR82 in /Users/bbuchsbaum/code/scala/plsneuro. Related native color repair bd-01M241Y5FPND8TPHTJQVHJWW7K.

The adaptive affine candidate removes the universal 4x geometry cost: the retained 549,018-face bilateral inflated cortex needs no splits under unlit, default directional, or softer directional lighting. However, inverting/restoring original RGB while lighting is active produces approximately 300 ms update+snapshot time versus about 40 ms unlit. Instrumented default-lighting warm updates spend 26-53 ms in backend.render and 264-291 ms in the subsequent snapshot. Each update uploads 13,176,432 UV bytes without a scientific/native topology rebuild. The initial call is slower and is recorded separately. This locates the expensive work after UV mutation; it is not yet a driver trace proving a particular internal mesh operation.

Independent examination of original Float normals and RGB finds 44,727 default-lighting constant/varying face transitions and 1,539 anchor changes; softer lighting has 46,530 and 1,465 respectively. Unlit inversion has neither. Removing constant-face UV specialization alone cannot eliminate the necessary anchor changes. Avoid premature caching that freezes an invalid anchor or changes color interpolation.

Evidence: /Users/bbuchsbaum/code/scala/plsneuro/output/brain-display/gpu-color-24 (raw commands, exact class/runtime inputs, original/instrumented images, independent counts, timing receipts); native QA protocol tools/surface-view/javafx-affine-color/production-plan.json. Three corrected runtime mechanisms remain jointly required: affine-safe encoding, no color mipmaps, centroid UV interpolation. Runtime pin is macOS ES2 JavaFX24.0.1; this is not packaged interactive frame-rate proof.

Acceptance: reproduce the update penalty through the public backend; measure CPU preparation, UV upload and native draw independently; identify an adapter-local or narrowly scoped runtime remedy that preserves original colors, IDs, picks, budgets and failure atomicity. Benchmark ordinary palette/threshold/FIR changes as well as this adversarial RGB inversion, with unchanged frames and actual interaction distinguished. Retain the 2-channel-level native oracle and permutation gates. No main-renderer changes made under this ticket yet. Existing color-correctness work can proceed independently; integration must retain this performance limit until qualified.
set.title: Recover retained-atlas optimization and qualify ordinary native update cost
